## Profile summary

AD3N1X builds practical web applications and learns through hands-on software projects. The work spans commerce workflows, public-source research, productivity tools, and interactive learning. The developer's approach emphasizes understanding the underlying problem, building useful workflows, responsive interfaces, maintainable implementation, security-conscious engineering, and testing important user journeys.

## Selected projects

### QuickCart

A commerce application designed for small businesses. It brings online storefronts, product catalogues, seller order management, customer order tracking, and delivery updates into one workflow. It is designed around practical small-business selling workflows; real-world seller adoption should not be assumed.

- Official project page: https://ad3n1x.github.io/QuickCart/
- Application: https://quick-cart-three-chi.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ad3n1x/QuickCart

### ADVERSE

An independent public-source search and research product. Its focus is helping people discover useful web destinations, explore research leads, and review public-source evidence while keeping source provenance and limitations visible. Automated analysis is an aid to research, not a substitute for verification.

- Website: https://adverse-web.onrender.com/
- Source: https://github.com/Ad3n1x/ADVERSE

### UNI-TRACK

A productivity and tracking web application for organising goals, habits, tasks, and workflows. The project explores practical productivity features and privacy-conscious design; do not interpret this as a guarantee of absolute privacy or universal end-to-end encryption.

- Website: https://unitrack-app.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ad3n1x/UNI-TRACK

### Cuewise

A conversation reflection and reply-coaching application. It supports screenshot text extraction, alternative interpretations, and editable reply suggestions. It is a writing and reflection aid, not a mind-reading system and cannot prove another person's intent.

- Website: https://ai-conv-help.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ad3n1x/AI-CONV-HELP

### Quiz App

An interactive learning application with STEM subject practice, configurable quizzes, and learning-focused challenges.

- Website: https://quiz-app-henna-omega.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ad3n1x/Quiz-App

The portfolio includes a live repository shelf sourced from the public GitHub profile. A repository's presence does not imply active maintenance, production readiness, user adoption, or affiliation with a third-party brand.

## Working principles

1. Understand the real user problem before choosing an implementation.
2. Build the core workflow before adding unnecessary complexity.
3. Make interfaces usable on mobile and desktop.
4. Treat authentication, data ownership, validation, and server-side secrets carefully.
5. Test important user journeys and distinguish a successful build from verified product behavior.
6. Describe limitations honestly and avoid unsupported performance, privacy, security, or adoption claims.

## Source priority

For current project descriptions and links, prefer the live portfolio and the linked project repositories. The portfolio is the primary profile source; project repositories are the primary implementation sources.
